value.name: SIBAL cotton-fiberglass blend
value.notes: single large burn sample; largest space fire experiment to date (prior largest was index-card size)

hardware_detail.value: Saffire enclosure (~0.5 m wide by 1 m deep by 1.3 m long) with flow duct and avionics bay, ignited in Cygnus after ISS departure, before destructive reentry

value: Investigate large-scale flame growth in space
Determine material flammability limits in microgravity

relevance_tags.note: tags assigned by curator from fact-sheet content

safety_pillars.note: flame growth and flammability limits are prevention; series-level results also inform emergency protocols

summary.value: Saffire-I (July 2016) ignited a 0.4 m by 1 m SIBAL fabric sample by hot wire in a dedicated enclosure aboard Cygnus after ISS departure, the first large-scale flame-growth and flammability-limit test in space.

airflow_cm_s.note: flow duct present but no velocity stated — confirm from PSI package

ignition_method.value: hot wire, commanded by ground controllers

variables.note: single-sample demonstration; cross-run variation is captured across Saffire-I/II/III, not within this record
